Hi Hannah,

Our renewal is up in June and we've started planning the environment changes for next year. The security team has asked us to isolate production traffic into a separate on-prem partition (air-gapped from our shared dev/staging VPC) and to add an additional cluster to support higher token throughput for our longitudinal search workload.

Can Redwood provide: a) a clear SOW for a dedicated on-prem partition, b) capacity guidance for +40% token throughput, and c) proposed term adjustments if we add a second on-prem cluster?

I'm looping procurement on this thread. We'd like a rough estimate by next week so we can include it in our renewal packet.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + on-prem partition request

Laura / Rajiv — thanks for the data. Quick technical summary and recommendation: 

- Sizing: To hit ~6k tokens/s 99p with 95% tail latency < 200ms, we recommend adding one additional cluster with 8x A100-equivalent nodes (quantized model), or 10x T4-equivalent for a lower-cost option with slightly higher latency.
- Isolation: We'll provision an independent KV store per partition and enforce network ACLs so there is no cross-tenant prefix scanning. That meets the PII isolation ask.
- Rollout: 2-week on-site deploy window for the initial cluster, plus a 1-week validation (SLO testing) phase.

Commercial ask (proposal):
- Add-on cluster commit: 8-node A100-equivalent pool; incremental monthly reserved rate: $68,000/mo
- Private partition setup fee (one-time): $45,000
- Recommended term options: 24-month with 10% discount or 36-month with 18% discount on the incremental commit.

I'll attach the updated SOW and a renewal term grid for Marissa to finalize.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Infrastructure Solutions
Redwood Inference
